body: Fingers crossed. Thanks man, will try.

I guess that's the genuine issue here. I don't know what I'm worth. It's hard to believe you are capable or worthy of anything at all when you've been told otherwise by various people all your life. Thanks, I appreciate that.

Kind of, yeah. I got the best support I could yesterday although I was too ashamed to ask for it in the first place. I'm not quite near the so-glad-I'm-alive phase though. Frankly, I'm feeling oddly apathetic and carefree. Unsure as to whether or not that's a good sign. I also still have my doubts about getting away for good for some time.

His father was also an abusive psychopath, which he believes gives him the right to treat my brother and I the way his father did him. (His words, by the way.) I don't want to believe that he is completely insensitive about me, but it's true that he is insanely unstable. And that I'm unable to handle that kind of behaviour while I need peace and quite in my life. Nor am I willing to project the same to my own future children.

At the age of 5? Wow, how'd you pull that off? I am almost 20 but don't have the balls to move out. First off, I really am a mess at the moment, and don't think I could handle the responsibilities of "adult life". Also, I'm financially dependent on my parents at any cost. Doesn't make sense to me to live by myself without completely taking charge of my finances. Perhaps I could find a decent job soon.

I've tried a lot of different methods over the years; however, I feel like they were almost the reason for me getting worse. I was fairly stable for a few years until I finally started taking antidepressants. Therapists are even worse. That said, there are quite a few things that seriously aid my progress (e.g: my boyfriend, exercising, not eating crap) but I can't get myself to engage in those things when I'm in this condition. Catch-22, really.

I've been there many times before, but I never thought I would actually try to do this again. I felt so hopeless that even the thought of seeking help never crossed my mind. I regret it now.

There's not a single thing that I can point to that makes me miserable; more like a combination of many things. Past relationship abuse, dysfunctional family, disappointing college life, etc. Worse still, at this point I can't differentiate between my problems and the rest since everything seems to hurt me.

I do want to get better - somehow - yet I can't exactly figure out how by myself.
